# Copilot Context

## Tech Stack

* Node.js
* Express.js
* Handlebars (HBS)
* Bootstrap 5
* HTML5
* CSS3
* Git and GitHub

## Project Structure

* app.js: Main application file
* routes/index.js: Contains all page routes
* views/layout.hbs: Shared layout, navigation bar, and footer
* views/index.hbs: Home page
* views/about.hbs: About Me page
* views/projects.hbs: Projects page
* views/contact.hbs: Contact Me page
* public/stylesheets/style.css: Custom styling

## Application Purpose

This application is a personal portfolio website for Khushdeep Kaur. It showcases personal information, technical skills, projects, and contact information in a professional and responsive website.

## Design Requirements

* Soft pink and cream colour palette
* Responsive design using Bootstrap
* Professional and clean layout
* Student-focused branding
